method.corpus: Maintained commerceFiles query modules and DDL for every ledger grammar; schema comes from the same example parser used by the playground, not live introspection.
method.contracts: Actual exported/reopened selected-core offline-rule contracts. Discover the matching public core export using each maintained snapshot's version evidence. No native evidence or qualification is manufactured; this does not measure native acquisition success or latency.
method.comparison: The unmodified base candidates are also analyzed independently through the compatibility analyzer. Record complete analysis equality and both diagnostic lists per exact candidate; this comparison does not qualify native correctness.
method.scaling: Copy 1 is the unmodified commerce workload. Copies 10/50 add SQL comments to create exact-text variants; these are synthetic identity-growth stress tests, not additional application features or production popularity.
method.runtime: All eligible TS query exports retained; SQL assets contribute artifacts but are excluded from both runtime bundle columns. rendererOnlyBundle has original tags; withValuePlansBundle has compiler-injected plans. Neither bundle contains schema snapshots or durable contract envelopes.
method.schemaGrowth: Add 50/500 unused product-shaped relations, validated by each owner. This isolates compiler-input growth from query-plan/runtime growth.
method.compression: gzip level 9; Brotli quality 11; closure compression uses sorted name/NUL/length/NUL/content framing, not a tarball or install size.
limitations: Example DDL snapshots are conservative partial models, not full live catalog snapshots; complete index/constraint/introspection metadata costs are excluded.
Curated application examples are not production telemetry, a usage ranking, or a proof of full SQL coverage.

Inexact/dynamic rendering stays visible and is excluded from exact artifacts; compilable runtime-sized fragments still contribute their selector plans to runtime bundles. Diagnostic template files are excluded from bundles.
Known runtime descriptors do not certify nullability, JSON shape, precision or all semantic facets.
Installation payload and native contract evidence overhead are separate measurements.
